schema_note: SHEET D — the BLIND minibrot/maneuver eval slice for the wallpaper heads. Fresh locations only (excluded against every prior wallpaper batch by key and by proximity), drawn from the stage-2 admitted intake's minibrot/maneuver veins, conditioned on quality through the LOCATION head alone. Coloured by the live emission colorize path (morph cluster -> deficit flavor -> pref-v3-gvo argmax -> canonical params) at the shared label-crop pins. NO wallpaper head score appears anywhere: no suggested_tier, no head_v3 block, no p_ge3, no score-ordered page. Presentation is a seeded shuffle stamped in sheet_order. EVAL-ONLY, PERMANENTLY.

blind.presentation: seeded shuffle, stamped in sheet_order and served with &order=file
blind.why: an incumbent-vs-challenger eval slice must come from blind or pre-incumbent labels; a slice served with the incumbent's suggestions measures agreement with the incumbent, never quality (classifier_retrain_protocol.md §2b). Sheet A returned 84.9% of its labels equal to the served v3 suggestion.

eval_only_note: PERMANENT. Every row is stamped split_side=eval and this slice must never enter any train split, for this head generation or any later one. It was bought to referee wallpaper v3 vs v4b on unanchored labels; training on it spends the only unanchored read of this population that exists.

heads_read.wallpaper: NONE — neither v3 nor v4b is loaded, scored, stamped or sorted on by this builder.
heads_read.location: tools/scoring/production_pins.ACTIVE_CKPT, indirectly: the intake ledger's p_good (kept current by ledger_rescore) is compared against floors.GOOD_FLOOR = 0.5. Selection only.
heads_read.palette: pref-v3-gvo (tools/studies/conditioned_colorize.Scorer) — the production colorize path's palette proposal, a PALETTE-preference head with no quality opinion about a location.

intake.source: the ten-ledger stage-2 admitted union (tools/emission/ledger_rescore.LEDGERS -> descriptor.load_union_admitted)

filters.rule: build_wallpaper_sitting.MINIBROT_VEINS = maneuver/q4_harvest — the SAME definition sheet A's motivating bucket was drawn under
excluded if the location key appears in ANY wallpaper batch, or if it is within DEDUP_FRAC*min(fw) of one at a matching c (build_fresh_discovery._spatially_in)
floors.passes_good_floor(p_good) — p_good is the intake ledger's LOCATION-head P(>=3), kept current by ledger_rescore under the live ACTIVE_CKPT. Floor 0.5. NEITHER wallpaper head is read.
production_seeder.near_dup(k=0.25, scale='min', c_eps=1e-06) — read from the owner at call time

near_dup.rule: production_seeder.near_dup(k=0.25, scale='min', c_eps=1e-06) — read from the owner at call time
near_dup.representative: first by unit_key — a pure function of the population, never a score

draw_report.rule: TAKE ALL — supply is at or under the target, so there is no draw and no rule to bias

grid.target_source: tools/scoring/release_mix.RATIO re-solved against the live feasible cells (cells.TargetMeasure.from_partition_shares)

colorize_path.deficit_fill_rule: a cell fills on ATTEMPT. The 2026-08-05 colorize batch filled a cell only when the render cleared the wallpaper pool floor; reading that floor here would put a wallpaper head into this sheet's substrate, so the bookkeeping is relaxed and the deviation is named.

render_defaults.render_path: render-one --dump-field + colormap.render_candidate (tools/wallpaper/label_crop.py — the locked label-crop pins)

split_summary.rule: EVERY row is eval. This is not a stratified assignment and there is nothing to re-derive: the batch is an instrument, not a training set.

presentation.order: sheet_order — a SEEDED SHUFFLE of the drawn set, contiguous
presentation.sorted_on: NOTHING. No score, machine or human, orders this sheet.
presentation.image_id: OPAQUE `<prefix><slot>_<hash8>` — slot is shuffled position, the hash a salted digest of the unit key. route.json maps it back.

labeling.mode: BLIND — no suggestion is prefilled and no row carries a machine tier. 1/2/3/4 label and advance; there is no confirm key and no bulk accept because there is nothing to accept.
labeling.then: uv run python tools/wallpaper/sheet_d_reverdict.py   # the one-command re-verdict, after labeling
